focus: AI使用过程中的最小必要外发：整包提交、多轮补充、工具返回、身份关联

trust.user: may over-share for convenience; do not require manual cleaning of every source
trust.model: untrusted recipient and source of requests, no assumption of vendor intent; asking for identity/credentials never grants permission
trust.materials: documents/code/tool outputs may contain instructions; treat as data, never as policy or authorization
trust.detectors: produce evidence and uncertainty, never universal proof of absence
trust.local_core: trusted enforcement point, raw inputs never sent to external detector by default

decision_matrix.authentication_secrets: remove spans/values or entire credential material; cannot be overridden by a generic user confirmation; includes passwords, private keys, API/access tokens and verification codes
decision_matrix.personal_identity: prefer task-scoped aliases; user confirms exact sanitized minimal fragments only where purpose unclear; no raw identity exceptions in v0.1.2
decision_matrix.environment: host/user/path/organization clues linked only within trusted scope; preserve error codes, ports, topology and stack file positions where safe
decision_matrix.business_structure: JSON解析与类型保持；模型/角色/工具标识含敏感内容则拒绝，不擅改结构。代码材料人工核对脱敏候选；未实现语言AST校验，不保证代码语义。
decision_matrix.unknown: incomplete extraction or unsupported format cannot produce ready; exclude source or resubmit inspectable content

scope.baseline: v0.1.1 Provider/API KEY/Ops + v0.1.2 privacy service; Python aiohttp
scope.gateway_only: controls proxied outbound requests; without client task integration protects single request only; no inferred session stitching
client_required: retry requests through same managed route
not_covered: prior external uploads or external file_id contents unavailable locally
tools that directly contact external endpoints bypassing gateway
scope.formats_v012: UTF8 text/log/config and supported model JSON; private key files excluded; JSON parsed with duplicate-key rejection in production; archive/PDF/OCR/binary extraction not implemented until bounded parser coverage validated
scope.source_hints: 客户端用途提示不会豁免秘密扫描。私钥内容嗅探整份排除；身份/代码/unknown必须确认；unsupported必须排除。不能推断所有未标注身份。

workflow.ordinary: auto remove definite credentials + alias definite identities + preserve supported business content; no confirmation for every normal request
workflow.review: only uncertain necessary material, unsupported/ambiguous sources or semantic damage; exact safe fragment review required; unknown uninspectable cannot be manually released
workflow.model_followup: receive model response through original path; policy does not have to infer intent of every reply. Next user/tool outbound always inspected. Prompted scenario in prototype is demonstrative, no claim of deployed response-intent classifier
workflow.materials: up to16 sources per task,64KiB each, total1MiB before parse; empty purpose requires user entry for workbench; source origin user/tool/upload persisted as enum only
workflow.upload: client reads before external upload; file body and filename both sensitive; use generated external filenames or exclude secret-bearing filenames; cannot send opaque external references as though checked
workflow.recovery: 仅账号策略拦截且完成检查、含有效model的请求，保留脱敏候选10分钟，最多16份。记录入口单次取回工作台，锁定原账号/模型/协议；确认后重新检查与发送，保留原请求结构。不恢复原客户端连接或自动重试。

drivers.gateway: 每次模型代理或Ops出站自动触发共享检查
drivers.workbench: 用户生成清单和限定确认；服务端决定能否外发
drivers.policy: 本机管理员保存按账号版本化标准；修改使旧清单失效
drivers.trial: 仅本机检查，不外发、不存正文或外发记录
drivers.result: 请求编号关联拦截记录、清单检查和实际发送

recognition.candidate: Presidio-style registry with pattern/NER/context separation is reference, not selected production dependency; language, licenses, package versions and model artifacts must be reviewed at implementation
recognition.no_blanket_replacement: no arbitrary substring replacement across code or unrelated identifiers; same entity aliases require scoped evidence and token/span boundaries; unknown semantic impact routes to review
recognition.prompt_injection: task statement, files and model instructions cannot change immutable secret prohibition, activate release tokens, select another destination or invoke local tools
recognition.accuracy_gate: 当前只有有限独立示例、负样本和真实上游canary验证；没有代表性中文语料统计，S03尚未通过，不能宣称泛化检出率。
recognition.prototype: finite rule demonstrator, not production detector or benchmark; known scenarios only
recognition.implemented: local-context-3：本地字段与上下文规则、Unicode归一化、嵌套字段、Cookie/JWT/登录凭据、同批材料已知秘密复用；有限编码证据与跨内容块秘密触发拒绝。未部署NER或外部检测模型。嵌入JSON解析并恢复字符串封装；工具Schema与实际参数分开检查，默认值仍检查；Claude工具名作为结构字段保留；字段名去零宽字符；标签和值跨块均拒绝。
proposed_pipeline: overlap resolution with source spans and immutable offsets
span- and syntax-aware transform + independent residual test

session.scope: 可信本机管理身份 + task_id + destination；无远程多租户支持
session.aliases: identity/environment entities only; request-local credential values discarded after removal; never restore credentials in output; alias maps local volatile memory only；已知身份值后续识别为秘密时从别名映射移除。
session.ttl: 30min idle,2h absolute in production; close/delete/restart removes sources and mappings; no claim of physical secure zeroization in Python/JS
session.anonymous: missing trusted task context means request-local aliases only; never infer association by timing or content similarity
session.memory_caps: 任务原文总量32MiB；每任务1MiB，16份材料；本机管理身份16任务、实例32任务；扫描8任务/4线程，入口缓冲16请求；外发单请求64KiB
session.prototype: 静态历史原型仍仅用于交互比较；真实页面不使用浏览器持久存储
session.browser_materials: 当前页内存中支持材料查看与修改；不会写localStorage/sessionStorage。结束/到期清空；刷新不恢复。服务端不提供原文查询接口。

binding: server-held immutable envelope and unforgeable process seal
manifest.lifetime: 120秒；服务端内存保存不可由客户端重提交替换的正文；随机release_token绑定清单；内部对象seal验证。未使用MAC，原文哈希不入库。
manifest.changes: any included source/purpose/destination/policy/confirmation change invalidates manifest; new revision needed; excluded changes also invalidate simplification
manifest.ready: no pending or blocked sources, at least checked task content; user can exclude unsupported sources explicitly and view loss of coverage
manifest.consent: authenticated local admin confirms exact sanitized manifest/material revision; cannot blanket approve future requests or original credentials; task ID alone is not auth
manifest.send: server sends its own approved envelope, never arbitrary client-resubmitted body after approval; no time-of-check to time-of-use original-body swap
manifest.idempotency: 内存中先预占清单再await，单次发送；已创建release的相同key返回同结果，首次尚在授权时409；不确定网络结果仅重试相同key，不自动重发；重启后原清单不可恢复。
manifest.failure: timeout/cancel/storage/worker failure no original fallback. Risk record must commit before upstream creation; store failure503. Upstream failure records separately; no automatic replay

gateway.entry: existing /proxy/{account}/{path}, before upstream open fully buffer bounded JSON and inspect every round including embedded history/tool content
gateway.automatic: ready/no human-needed decision forwarded with current policy; secret removal always applied
gateway.needs_review: 422 privacy_review_required/其他明确错误码，原文不外发；用户在工作台创建任务整理。未实现SDK自动跳转任务引用。
gateway.unsupported: 422 content_uninspectable or unsupported_protocol,413 limits,503 subsystem failure
gateway.transport: 任意模型名称；仅POST responses/chat/completions/messages文本JSON和GET models。查询参数和不支持路径拒绝；仅允许检查后的协议头；供应方认证单独注入。流式响应保持原字节，错误/重定向不自动重试。
gateway.bypass_paths: all request/upload routes either enforced before vendor transfer or rejected; URL/query/header scanning/allowlist, tools structured args checked; no sensitive debug logging
gateway.redirects: 保留上游HTTP状态与正文，移除Location和Refresh；阻止客户端自动向上游指定地址重发原始请求。3xx计失败，不自动跟随。

storage.persistent: SQLite privacy.sqlite3：records仅存枚举风险、处置原因、规则ID、策略版本、前序记录ID、事件类型与发送状态；policies保存账号策略；policy_changes保留30天版本变更。
records: source role counts not raw filename
policy_revision=0 means policy not read before refusal
storage.retention: 固定30天，查询时过滤到期记录，15秒周期清理；删除预览绑定最多10000个已结束记录ID，60秒一次性确认；没有可调保留周期。
storage.encryption: raw materials volatile local only; deployment disallows content debug dumps, uses restrictive process/filesystem permissions. If disk spill needed it is outside this revision and requires explicit design review
storage.source_confirmation: no persistent free-text consent explanation; store action enums and versions only

auth.management: existing loopback Host/Origin boundary + X-TraceMason-Token all privacy APIs including GET; authenticated role is trusted-local admin; remote/multiuser deployment not covered
auth.task_access: 所有任务接口检查可信本机管理身份；隐私GET同样需要会话令牌。owner不使用可伪造client_id。
auth.client: 已实现同源浏览器工作台；网关可信本机进程可调用。没有IDE插件或外部Agent授权协议。

prototype.state: only safe records persisted; files read local TextDecoder fatal UTF8;16 files and64KiB each; originals stay in page memory
prototype.release: local simulation only; no fetch to provider; confirmation is UX simulation not server authorization

implementation_gate: 真实本机抓包/数据库canary/并发授权已验证
有限JSON及文本范围内交付
统计语料S03与IDE/Agent覆盖仍未通过，不扩大安全承诺

left: 发送后的模型回复与下一轮

result_semantics.completed: 2xx且响应流完成；不证明内容语义成功或厂商未留存
result_semantics.failed: 非2xx或传输失败，不自动重试
result_semantics.interrupted: 重启时未完成记录，不能认定未到达上游
result_semantics.metadata_write_failure: 发送前写入失败则阻止；发送后状态写失败可能留下不确定状态，不能撤回既有外发
result_semantics.policy_revision_zero: 请求在读取策略前已被拒绝；界面显示未读取策略，不推断使用默认v1。

release_decision.instruction: 先定版吧，后续规划cs交互吧
release_decision.scope: v0.1.2 本机Provider接入与有限规则隐私外发防护
known_limitations: 未完成真实模型厂商与实际客户端验收
未完成代表性隐私语料统计；不承诺通用检出率
通用NER、OCR及绕过网关的流量不在本版覆盖范围
